title: Ultimatum
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight leads the volunteer crime patrol group Knights of the Night while Jim searches for his Blackberry. Michael grapples with anxiety over Holly's ultimatum to AJ to propose by New Year's, only to discover Holly is not engaged, which brings him relief and celebration. Meanwhile, Pam introduces a New Year's resolution board to the office, prompting coworkers to share and pursue personal goals. Dwight, Andy, and Darryl attempt to meet women through various schemes, and Michael supports Creed in learning to do a cartwheel, symbolizing encouragement and personal growth. Holly suggests taking a break in her relationship with Michael, leaving the outcome uncertain.
